notes.title: BabushCats Demo releases!
notes.content:
[h1]Babushcats Demo Is Here![/h1]

Spring has arrived, and with it comes the [b]Babushcats Demo[/b]. This version brings refined and improved content, offering a more engaging experience. You'll find:
[list]
[*] More ways to care for your cats
[*] Improved combat attractiveness
[*] Upgraded weapons and abilities
[*] A single boss to challenge your skills
[/list]Jump in and let us know what you think! Your feedback will help shape the game.

[h2]Watch the New Babushcats Trailer![/h2]

Alongside the demo, we’re excited to share a fresh look at Babushcats in our latest trailer. 
Get a glimpse here:

[previewyoutube=lVLLPukMT-o;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Join Our Discord – Share Your Feedback![/h2]

Your thoughts on the Babushcats demo are incredibly valuable to us. Every comment, suggestion, and bug report helps shape the game into something better. We’d love to hear what you think!

You can join our [b]Discord Community Server[/b] here: https://discord.gg/UpA8vKRA4H
